Great variety of modifications for your pet to give it a new look and make it look cool accessories.
Customize your cat as you like!
It's not much of a mystery, without much more to add, I hope you enjoy it![/size]


[i][b][size=5][color=#ff0000]The mod has several options, designed for mods that allow you to have more than one cat in your farm, if you do not have this type of mods, [/color][color=#ffff00][u]only modify the first variant[/u].[/color][/size][/b]
[/i]
[size=6][color=#ffff00][b]
[i][u]Mod Options:[/u][/i][/b][/color][color=#ff7700] 
[/color][/size][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]I recommend using the Mod: "[/b][/size][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]". To read what each option does from this menu[/b][/size][/color][size=6]
[/size][color=#00ff00][b]
[i][size=5]Some options have the variable "Random" which allows you to change the object placed on your cat automatically every day.[/size][/i]
[/b][/color][size=1][b]
[i]Cats don't have eyes...[/i][/b][/size][/font]
